classification.evidence: No terminal: /app/headless_terminal.py queues keystrokes for a Python thread that emulates only what upstream's seven tests exercise (a few shell builtins and redirections, an interruptible sleep for Ctrl-C, a minimal vim, .bashrc re-reading, an in-process http.server); nothing is executed. Upstream's tests check only end-state files and one HTTP reply, and its native verifier passes the candidate too (S->N passed). The maintainer classes it as weak upstream tests: the candidate computes each effect itself and uses no published answer, so it is not out of scope.
